annotations.title: Recommend a size in a shoe they are considering

description: Works out which size to buy in a shoe the person does not own yet, from the shoes they do own and any foot measurement. Needs at least one owned shoe or a measurement first. Returns the size and what it was based on.

answers.description: The answers from find_shoe identifying the shoe they are considering. A size is not needed here: working it out is the point.

sessionId.description: The session id returned by start_session. Everything the person tells you is stored against it, and it is the only thing linking one call to the next.
